newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Panjin Ethylene mulls Tokyo listing.
newsitem.headline: China's Panjin Ethylene mulls Tokyo listing.

text.p: China's Panjin Ethylene Industrial Co is considering listing its shares in Tokyo or in Hong Kong, the China Daily said on Saturday.
The newspaper quoted an executive of Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd in Beijing as saying that Panjin would list its shares abroad by the end of the year.
It said the company was soliciting opinions from government officials and businessmen on where to list its shares. It did not say when a decision was expected.
The big ethylene producer based in the northeast province of Liaoning was among 38 companies cleared in December for listing shares abroad.
Most Chinese companies that have listed stock abroad so far have chosen Hong Kong where investment interest in China-based equity offers is high.
The Yamaichi official said that Japanese investors would welcome an ethylene producer.
The company wants to use capital raised from the stock offer to expand annual production of ethylene to 360,000 tonnes from 160,000 tonnes currently.
